lines.zh: 我的枝条绞着走，一步一顿。
lines.en: My limbs are woven branches; I lurch step by step.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线走，不声不响。
lines.en: I walk the treeline without a sound.

lines.zh: 脚掌落在落叶上，几乎没有声。
lines.en: My feet on the leaf litter barely sound.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把断枝捡起来。
lines.en: As I walk I pick up broken branches.
My walk is crooked, but it's sure.
The grain in my trunk shifts as I move.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵老树转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle an old tree half way.
One stride over the roots.
I stop at the edge of the shade.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一根枯枝，很响。
lines.en: I snap a dry branch — loudly.

lines.zh: 两棵树之间，我只走直线。
lines.en: Between trees, I walk straight lines.
The branches behind me sway.
I stand with my branches spread wide.

lines.zh: 我身上的树皮在轻轻响。
lines.en: The bark on me creaks faintly.

lines.zh: 有一只鸟落在我的肩上。
lines.en: A bird settles on my shoulder branch.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像这林子里的一棵。
lines.en: Still as I am, I'm just another tree.
I turn my head slowly and look a long while.
My eyes are two deep hollows.
Vines creep slowly over me.

lines.zh: 我听见林子里每一声响。
lines.en: I hear every sound in the wood.
I haven't moved in a long time.
I lower my head a little.

lines.zh: 我这张木脸没有表情，可我在看。
lines.en: My wooden face shows nothing, but I am watching.
I saw you the moment you came in.
I lower my head to your level.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，穿过林子我都听见。
lines.en: Your breathing comes through the trees to me.
I don't intend to let you pass.
The trees here all know me.
I raise my hand and my branches spread.
You're in my shade — it's dark.
I lean down slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的木头裂了一块。
lines.en: A piece of my timber has split.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，落叶都翻起来。
lines.en: I give half a step and the leaves turn over.
I turn my head inch by inch.
One of my branches has broken.
I straighten and I don't run.
Splinters fall off me.
I hold motionless, silent as bark.

lines.zh: 我记住了这一下的味道。
lines.en: I'll remember the taste of that blow.

lines.zh: 斧痕留在我的腰上，木屑在掉。
lines.en: An axe scar stays on my waist, shedding splinters.
You're holding something of wood.
That timber still smells fresh.
I slowly extend one branch.
That isn't from me.
I sniff it; it's familiar.
I've taken it in my hand.
I could let you pass.
It's the same as mine.
I haven't smelled this in a long time.
I tuck it away slowly.
You hit me like hitting a tree.
Not even a leaf of me stirred.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我肩上掉了些碎屑。
lines.en: That knocked some splinters off my shoulder.
You were flung back several steps.
My branches scraped you.
I shift half my bulk aside.
All this timber weighs more than you.
I pause and wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 这片林里只有我一个在走。
lines.en: I'm the only one who walks in this wood.
The trees don't speak, and neither do I.
I lay my hand on a trunk.
It's quieter than I am.

lines.zh: 我守着它们，它们替我遮着。
lines.en: I watch over them; they shade me.
At night I can hear them grow.
One of them is slowly dying.
I stand beside it.
I stay until dawn.
I pick up that broken branch.
I fit it into myself.
It doesn't fit; I set it down.

lines.zh: 我握住它，听见里面的声音。
lines.en: I hold it and hear the sound inside.
This wood is still alive.
I push it into the soil.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块石头，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and study it.
This is too dry; it crumbles.
I put it in a hollow.
I set it under my feet.

lines.zh: 木头做的监视者，也会转头。
lines.en: Even a wooden watcher can turn its head.
My branches moved first.
One stride and I have you.
I lay my branches across the front.

lines.zh: 藤蔓悄悄绕到你脚踝后面。
lines.en: A vine quietly curls behind your ankle.
The tree shadows have covered you.
There's dense wood at your back.
I spread my branches to either side.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的叶子，替我报了位置。
lines.en: The leaves you crushed told me where you are.

lines.zh: 朝你压过去，树影都歪了。
lines.en: Pressing in on you. Even the tree shadows lean.
The ground sinks under my feet.
You've raised what you're holding.

lines.zh: 我的关节咔了一声，接着迈步。
lines.en: My joints creak once, then I take a step.

lines.zh: 枯枝在我脚下断成两截。
lines.en: Dead branches snap in two under my feet.
You go left; my branches block left.
I've covered this whole area.
You're quick, but there's little room.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩断的每一根枝。
lines.en: I hear every twig you break.
That tree leaned out of my way.
I've raised my hand as high as it goes.

lines.zh: 我的枝条垂下来，像笼子。
lines.en: My branches hang down like a cage.
You hit them and fell back.
I'm drawing the ring tighter.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两步的地方。
lines.en: I stop two steps from you.

lines.zh: 我的影子完全盖住了你。
lines.en: My shadow covers you completely.

lines.zh: 我的木指节一格一格地弯下来。
lines.en: My wooden knuckles bend down one joint at a time.
You've stopped running.

lines.zh: 我把枝条从上面压下来。
lines.en: I bring my branches down from above.

lines.zh: 这一片林子都是我的手脚。
lines.en: This whole wood is my limbs.

lines.zh: 我把身体的正面完全转过来。
lines.en: I've turned my full front to face you.
One of my branches sweeps down.

lines.zh: 这一下把它打倒在落叶里。
lines.en: That knocked it into the leaf litter.
My branches wrap its legs.
My trunk slams into it.
It's thrown against a trunk.
My hand has caught it.
I close my branches slowly.

lines.zh: 整根树干砸下来，落叶飞起。
lines.en: A whole trunk slams down and leaves fly up.
It lies still on the ground.

lines.zh: 断枝像鞭子一样抽在它背上。
lines.en: A broken branch lashes across its back like a whip.
The leaf litter is thrown up.

lines.zh: 我把枝条一根根收回来。
lines.en: I draw my branches back, one by one.
I stand there and watch.

lines.zh: 枝条一根接一根地打下去。
lines.en: My branches strike, one after another.
I throw it into the brush.
The leaves cover it.
I stop and step back.

lines.zh: 它还在挣，我的枝梢又压下去。
lines.en: It still struggles, so my branch tips press down again.

lines.zh: 我从树里走出来，树皮裂开了。
lines.en: I step out of a tree as its bark splits.

lines.zh: 第一口气是木头的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of wood.

lines.zh: 我的枝条一根根舒展开。
lines.en: My branches unfold one by one.

lines.zh: 四周的树都朝我倾了一点。
lines.en: The trees all lean toward me a little.

lines.zh: 我低头，看见地上有很多落叶。
lines.en: I look down at the deep leaf litter.

lines.zh: 一根藤从我的肩上垂下来。
lines.en: A vine hangs from my shoulder.
The light comes from behind me.
The wood goes silent at once.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在往这边走。
lines.en: I hear someone coming this way.
I straighten my waist slowly.
Roots shift under my feet.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的枝条往上烧。
lines.en: Fire climbs my branches.
I hit the ground and half of me scatters.
Water soaks my wood and I sink.
The blast snaps my branches off.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进了我的树干。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my trunk.
Something has bound my roots.

lines.zh: 土里没东西了，我在干枯。
lines.en: Nothing left in the soil; I'm drying out.
Lightning splits an old limb.
The ground gives and I fall with my roots.
